mainEntity.name: How do I install WolfBot Community?

acceptedAnswer.text: Download the installer for your platform from community.wolfbot.io/download. Windows: run Setup.exe. Linux: install the .deb package. Full guides are available for Windows and Linux.

mainEntity.name: Does WolfBot Community work on Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. WolfBot Community supports Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit). Download the Setup.exe installer from the download page.

mainEntity.name: Does WolfBot Community work on Ubuntu?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. WolfBot Community supports Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Debian 12+. Download the .deb package from the download page.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a VPS to run WolfBot Community?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. WolfBot Community runs on your personal Windows or Linux machine. A VPS is optional if you want 24/7 operation without keeping your PC on. Many users start on their desktop and move to a VPS later.

mainEntity.name: What happens when my PC shuts down?

acceptedAnswer.text: When WolfBot Community stops, your positions remain on the exchange—WolfBot is non-custodial and never holds your funds. After restart, WolfBot recovers your positions and resumes monitoring. For 24/7 operation, consider running on a VPS.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between WolfBot Community and WolfBot Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: WolfBot Community is free and self-hosted — you install and manage it on your own machine. WolfBot Cloud is a managed service where we handle hosting, infrastructure, and provide direct support. Community is ideal if you want full control and zero cost; Cloud is ideal if you want a ready-to-use managed experience.
